description: This file defines mock classes for the IMediaPipeline and IMediaPipelineFactory interfaces used in the Rialto media pipeline component. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: MediaPipelineFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IMediaPipelineFactory interface, used to create media pipeline instances in tests.

classes.name: MediaPipelineMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IMediaPipeline interface, providing mock implementations of media pipeline methods for testing.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates a mock media pipeline instance with specified client and video requirements.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline client.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type, MIME type, and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source by its ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the current playback position.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window position and size.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Checks if data is available for a given status and request ID.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the pipeline.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a video frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Checks if the audio is muted.
